method: Original eight condition bodies, three named/zero initializer entries and original SCP comparator. Synthetic valid records/definitions/group members/actor arrays/packet fields and signed global dword values. Named-character callback0x923904 alone is adapted.

adapters.scope: ASCII names map to reference records or null; callback retains null-system calls. References that share physical-object first pointer remain distinct.

limits: No game execution,reference lifetime,group construction,spline updates or population of aggregate globals.
IsAlive reads initialized record+4 definition without guard; missing definition faults native and portable source throws explicitly.
Solo IsAlive tests live bit1000 without active bit1; grouped members need both. An existing zero-count group overrides solo liveness.
MySet has no packet-null guard; actual faults saved,portable source throws explicitly.
Prepared group member arrays honor uint8 count through255; generic malformed/out-of-backing memory is outside scope.
Actor array uses original stride0x10d8; counted records and liveness fields must be prepared.
Global NumBaddiesThatCanSeePlayers is signed dword read; tests compare float32 storage boundary used by SCP evaluator.
ASCII names only in portable source; alias policy and callback side effects beyond fixture resolution external.
Managed execution pending under existing EPERM restriction; no launch retry.
